messages:
maria chen: Quick summary — ran quantized moxie9b (int6 AOT) on consumer chat slice. Seeing 2.8x cost reduction vs baseline 13b float, but GTN recall dipped ~4.5 pts on our longform eval. Need recommendations for routing/rollout.
jamal rai: numbers pls? latency / p95 / token cost?
maria chen: p50 110ms, p95 430ms (seq 512). tokens/unit cost down from $0.00012/token to $0.000043/token. Throughput roughly same. Quality: GTN_recall 86.3 -> 81.8 on 1k eval set.
alex b: saw similar on local smoke — hallucination on long contexts increased. Failure mode: prompt truncation + temp. Quick diff: sampling params shifted slightly after quant.
sophie ng: is there a hybrid routing win? e.g., short/cheap -> moxie-int6, long/complex -> 13b float. Canary %?
jamal rai: agree hybrid. Suggest split by token-count or an eval classifier. Economics: run break-even for 95/5 split: overall cost drops ~35% while keeping GTN within 1 pt if routing threshold tuned.
maria chen: ran a quick sim: with 90% short->int6, 10% fallback to 13b, GTN avg 85.9, cost -30%. Details below.
maria chen: ```
slice: consumer_chat_long
int6_cost_per_1k = 0.043
float13_cost_per_1k = 0.12
sim: 0.9*0.043 + 0.1*0.12 = 0.0577 -> 52% reduction vs all-13b
GTN_avg = 85.9
```
infra-bot: deploy job #7042 started for canary routing flag moxie-int6-fallback-13b (eta ~12m). :gear:
deploy-bot: canary deployed to us-west-2 region, route flag alpha:moxie_hybrid=on
alex b: one more caveat — KV cache behavior with int6 seems noisier; warmstart helps. Recommend 5-minute warm cache before full ramp.
sophie ng: product ask: for GTN/GTN-team — recommend we aim for <=1 pt drop vs baseline. If we can't hit that with routing, don't ship to default. Also propose an experiment label: moxie-hybrid-2026q1.
jamal rai: ops plan: start 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% in 48h windows, with automatic rollback on GTN_drop > 1.5 pts or latency p95 > 550ms.
maria chen: final recs: (1) enable hybrid routing by token-length threshold, (2) use int6 profile with warmstart, (3) follow canary schedule above, (4) gating metric = GTN_recall + latency SLOs, (5) run A/B with product cohort for 2 weeks. I'll draft the scorecard and rollout PR.
alex b: :thumbsup:
sophie ng: thanks — please cc me on PR for GTN cohort definitions.
maria chen: will do. tagging jamal for cost calc ownership. Thanks all.
